# CANDIDATE: VWAP_RIBBON_VOLUME_BREAK

**Filed:** 2026-08-24
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Price breaking VWAP with aligned EMA ribbon (9-EMA > 20-EMA > 50-EMA) and above-average volume (>1.5x 20-period average) signals sustained momentum. This edge exists because it combines institutional participation (volume surge) with trend confirmation (ribbon alignment) and dynamic support/resistance (VWAP break), reducing false breaks in low-to-moderate volatility regimes.

## Mechanism

Entry: When price closes above VWAP, the 9-EMA is above 20-EMA and 20-EMA above 50-EMA (bullish ribbon), and the bar's volume is >1.5x the 20-period average volume, then go long at close. Exit: Initial stop placed at the prior swing low (most recent LL) or 1% below entry, whichever is tighter; take profit 1 at 1.5R; runner trailed by chandelier exit (3*ATR) or 15% off high-water mark. Regime hint: Best in low-to-moderate VIX (<20) and during regular market hours (09:45-15:30) when trends are clearer; avoid during choppy VIX >30.
